title: The MOST important part of your LinkedIn Profile ✍️
description:
There's a lot of advice on what to put on your resume vs not, but have you ever wondered what exactly recruiters see when looking for candidates? More or less, it looks close to your public profle but there are a few sections that are collapsed that make your HEADLINE end up standing out. So what's the goal? Make sure you're searchable, have your recent updated history and ensure your profile reads like the intended role you want with your headline packed of good content. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
